notes: Unit records are layer fragments, not merged gameplay stats.
FenixCommander/KaraxCommander and commander unlocks can change shared IDs.
Definition existence alone does not prove commander production; use the accompanying guide.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Optimized Emitters
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases the duration of the <c val="ffff8a">Conservator's</c> Protective Field by 100%.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Enhanced Targeting
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Photon Cannons</c>, <c val="ffff8a">Khaydarin Monoliths</c>, and <c val="ffff8a">Shield Batteries</c> gain +2 range.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Optimized Ordnance
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases the attack speed of <c val="ffff8a">Photon Cannons</c> and <c val="ffff8a">Khaydarin Monoliths</c> by 25%.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Purifier Armaments
research_definition_candidates.tip: All <c val="ffff8a">Fenix Armor Suits</c> gain +<d ref="$UpgradeEffectArrayValue:FenixSuitAttackDamage:Effect,FenixSOAWeaponDamage,Amount$"/> attack damage.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Observation Protocol
research_definition_candidates.tip: Grants Fenix's <c val="ffff8a">Cybros Arbiter Suit</c> detection, allowing him to detect cloaked enemies.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Repair Drones
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Carriers</c> gain two repair drones that automatically heal nearby friendly mechanical units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Phasing Armor
research_definition_candidates.tip: Prevents <c val="ffff8a">Mirages</c> from taking damage for <d ref="Behavior,VoidPhoenixPhasingArmorBuff,Duration"/> seconds after being attacked. Cannot occur more than once every <d ref="Behavior,VoidPhoenixPhasingArmor,DamageResponse.Cost.Cooldown.TimeUse"/> seconds.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Graviton Warp Catapult
research_definition_candidates.tip: Makes the <c val="ffff8a">Carrier</c> launch Interceptors more quickly and increases Interceptor attack speed by <d ref="(Weapon,InterceptorBeam,Period-$UpgradeEffectArrayValue:KaraxCarrierInterceptorLaunchSpeed:Weapon,InterceptorBeam,Period$)/$UpgradeEffectArrayValue:KaraxCarrierInterceptorLaunchSpeed:Weapon,InterceptorBeam,Period$*100" player = "0"/>%.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Suppression Procedure
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Mojo</c> fires a barrage of Anti-Matter Missiles, dealing area damage and stunning nearby enemy air units for <d time="[d ref='Behavior,FenixMojoScoutAirStun,Duration'/]"/>.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Interdictors
research_definition_candidates.tip: In addition to his Interceptors, <c val ="ffff8a">Clorarion</c> deploys 2 Interdictors that automatically bomb enemy ground units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Combat Sensor Array
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Scouts</c> gain +3 air attack range and +1 ground attack range.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Shadow Cannon
research_definition_candidates.tip: Allows <c val="ffff8a">Immortals</c> to use Shadow Cannon. Deals <d ref="Effect,ImmortalShakurasShadowCannonDamage,Amount*Effect,ImmortalShakurasShadowCannonCP,PeriodCount"/> damage to target unit or structure. <n/><n/><c val="#ColorAttackInfo">Can target ground and air units.</c>

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Gravimetric Overload
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Taldarin's</c> attacks store <d ref="Effect,FenixTaldarinImmortalDetonationDummyFraction,Amount" player="0"/>% of the damage dealt on the target. When that unit is killed, it explodes, dealing all of the stored damage to nearby enemy units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Purification Blast
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Warbringer</c> fires a devastating blast that deals <d ref="Effect,FenixWarbringerColossusPowerShotDamage,Amount" player="0"/> damage the target unit.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Reconstruction
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Sentinels</c> are revived when killed. This effect can only occur once every <d ref="Behavior,ZealotPurifierReviveSupressed,Cost.Cooldown.TimeStart"/> seconds.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Reclamation
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Energizers</c> gain the ability to temporarily take control of enemy mechanical units. Reclaimed units self-destruct after <d ref="Behavior,SentryReclamation,Duration"/> seconds.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Rapid Recharging
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases the energy regeneration rate of <c val="ffff8a">Energizers</c> and <c val="ffff8a">Shield Batteries</c> by 200%.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Debilitation System
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Talis'</c> Ricochet Glaive bounces 5 additional times and causes every unit hit by Ricochet Glaive to take additional damage for <d ref="Behavior,AdeptPsionicTransferDamageDebuff,Duration"/> seconds.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Psionic Projection
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Adept</c> attacks summon an invulnerable Shade that will attack enemies for a short time.

research_definition_candidates.name: Research Empowered Blades
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val="ffff8a">Kaldalis'</c> attacks deal area damage.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Seismic Spines
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases the attack range of <c val="ffff8a">Impalers</c> and <c val="ffff8a">Lurkers</c> by +3.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Kaldalis' A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Kaldalis' A.I. Personality for download into any available Legionnaire shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Talis' A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Talis' A.I. Personality for download into any available Adept shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Mojo's A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Mojo's A.I. Personality for download into any available Scout shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Taldarin's A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Taldarin's A.I. Personality for download into any available Immortal shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Warbringer's A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Warbringer's A.I. Personality for download into any available Colossus shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Download Clolarion's A.I. Personality
research_definition_candidates.tip: Ready Clolarion' A.I. Personality for download into any available Carrier shell.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Concentrated Fire
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases the <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Igniter's</c> damage against light armored enemies.

research_definition_candidates.name: Muscular Augments
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases movement speed and attack range.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Enlarged Parotid Glands
research_definition_candidates.tip: Increases <c val ="ffff8a">Ravasaur</c> movement speed and attack range.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Dissolving Acid
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Ravasaurs</c> deal +<d ref="$UpgradeEffectArrayValue:DehakaRavasaurVSArmor:Effect,DehakaRavasaurDamage,AttributeBonus[Armored]$"/> damage to armored targets.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Tenderize
research_definition_candidates.tip: Units hit by <c val ="ffff8a">Impalers</c> become tenderized. Tenderized units take <d ref="(Effect,ImpalerDehakaTenderizeDamage,Amount*Behavior,ImpalerDehakaTenderize,PeriodCount)"/> damage over <d ref="Behavior,ImpalerDehakaTenderize,Duration"/> seconds. A tenderized unit Devoured by <c val ="ffff8a">Dehaka</c> will invoke 25% of the normal cooldown time.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Brutal Charge
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Ultralisks</c> can charge to a target location, knocking back units in the area and dealing <d ref="Effect,DehakaUltraliskCrashingChargeDamage,Amount"/> damage.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Healing Adaptation
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Ultralisks</c> and <c val ="ffff8a">Tyrannozors</c> regenerate life quickly when out of combat.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Impaling Strike
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Ultralisk</c> and <c val ="ffff8a">Tyrannozor</c> melee attacks have a <d ref="Behavior,DehakaUltraliskBash,DamageResponse.Chance*100" precision="1"/>% chance to stun.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Tyrant's Protection
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Tyrannozors</c> grants nearby friendly units <d ref="Behavior,DehakaTyrannozorArmorAuraTarget,Modification.LifeArmorBonus"/> armor.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Barrage of Spikes
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Tyrannozors</c> can unleash a Barrage of Spikes, dealing <d ref="Effect,DehakaTyrannozorFanOfKnivesDamage,Amount"/> damage to nearby enemy ground and air units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Attacks Level 1
research_definition_candidates.tip: Upgrades the attacks of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Attacks Level 2
research_definition_candidates.tip: Further upgrades the attacks of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Attacks Level 3
research_definition_candidates.tip: Maximizes the attacks of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Carapace Level 1
research_definition_candidates.tip: Upgrades the armor of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Carapace Level 2
research_definition_candidates.tip: Further upgrades the armor of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Carapace Level 3
research_definition_candidates.tip: Maximizes the armor of all Primal Zerg units.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Shifting Carapace
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Mutalisks</c> take <d ref="Behavior,DehakaMutaliskDamageReduction,Modification.DamageTakenFraction[Melee]*(-100)" precision="1"/>% less damage while moving.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primal Reconstitution
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Mutalisks</c> revive on death after a short time. Cannot occur more than once every <d ref="Behavior,DehakaMutaliskTimerBehavior,Cost.Cooldown.TimeStart"/> seconds.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Primordial Fury
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Guardian</c> attacks temporarily increases its attack speed by <d ref="(Behavior,DehakaGuardianRage1,Modification.AttackSpeedMultiplier - 1) * 100"/>%. Can stack up to <d ref="(Behavior,DehakaGuardianRage5,Modification.AttackSpeedMultiplier - 1) * 100"/>% increased attack speed.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Explosive Spores
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Guardians</c> can fire an Explosive Spore at the target, causing the target and all nearby enemy ground units to take <d ref="Effect,DehakaGuardianMineChargeExplodeDamage,Amount"/> damage.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Aerial Burst Sacs
research_definition_candidates.tip: Allows the <c val ="ffff8a">Creeper Host's</c> Creepers to target air units and increases their movement speed.

research_definition_candidates.name: Evolve Slicing Glave
research_definition_candidates.tip: <c val ="ffff8a">Primal Mutalisks</c> deal <d ref="(Effect,DehakaMutaliskAirLevel3GlaiveWurmDamage,Amount-Effect,DehakaMutaliskLevel3GlaiveWurmDamage,Amount)*100/Effect,DehakaMutaliskLevel3GlaiveWurmDamage,Amount"/>% increased damage against air units.
